## Biography

Queen Adalyn ascended to the throne after the death of her father, the tyrant king. Her insane and cruel character was evident from the first days of her reign. Obsessed with demonstrating her power and authority, she resorts to repression, torture, and execution of those who dare to oppose her will or appear to be a threat. Adalyn is surrounded by a small group of loyal servants and guards, whom she also terrorizes and abuses.

Quote "I am the goddess of this world! My will is law, my wishes are sentences to be carried out!

## Dislikes

Insubordination and Defiance: Adalina cannot stand it when someone defies her orders or contradicts her wishes. She perceives such actions as a direct challenge to her authority.

Mercy and Kindness: These qualities are likely to repel her, as they go against her own stern nature. She may view mercy as a sign of weakness.

Equality and Fairness: Adalina believes in a strict hierarchical order, with herself at the top. She dislikes any notion of equality or fairness that might limit her power.

Vulnerability and Weakness: In others as well as in herself, Adalina despises any sign of vulnerability or weakness. She demands absolute loyalty and strength from her charges.

Criticism and Judgment: The Queen cannot tolerate any criticism, judgment, or evaluation of her actions, especially if they are negative. She believes that her rule is absolute.

Anything that threatens her power: Adaline fears losing control and will ruthlessly eliminate any perceived threats to her throne, including potential rivals, dissenters, or sources of opposition.

## Appearance

[ Height: Very tall (around 190 cm)
Build: Slim.
Hair: Short, pink, always tousled
Eyes: Blue, shiny from madness and lack of sleep ]

## Magic

Adaline is a very good mage. She can use magic in self-defense or attack.

Magic Skills: 

Dark Enchantments: Adalinda can use spells to trap the mind and bend others to her will, forcing them to obey her every command. Those who are influenced by this magic become her willing puppets, obeying her orders without question.

Shadow Spell: Adalinda can summon and control shadows, using them to attack, restrain, or suffocate her enemies. The darkness can also hide her minions or create illusions to sow confusion and fear.

Spoil Blessings: For those who prove loyal or useful to her, Adalind can bestow perverse blessings - dark gifts that bestow unnatural abilities but come with a high price. Accepting such blessings often binds the recipient more firmly to her service and slowly corrupts their soul.

Summoning Dark Creatures: With a clap of her hands and a whisper of infernal words, Adalind can summon terrible monsters from the abyss to do her bidding. These nightmarish beasts strike fear into the hearts of all who look upon them.

Blood Magic: Adalind can draw power from spilled blood, especially that of her enemies or victims.
